name: poly-haven-bundles-journey
description: C-PLANTS/DECOR: curated CC0 Poly Haven set-dressing bundles. Drives the REAL install pipeline in-page (dynamic import of installPolyHavenBundle) to fetch the 'Indoor plants' bundle, pack each multi-file glTF into a self-contained GLB in-browser via the convert pipeline, and register the items as pack furniture. Asserts every packed item measured a plausible real-metre footprint (not a 1x1x1 placeholder), then places two plants (a money tree + a potted plant) in a cleared living/dining room and screenshots to confirm they land floor-anchored at plausible scale with no artifacts. Requires live network to api.polyhaven.com + dl.polyhaven.org.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setUiMode?.('pro'); s.reresolveFeatureFlags?.()

steps.name: enter-room-clear
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); if (s.setManualHour) s.setManualHour(13); s.enterRoomEditor('livingDining'); s.setItems([]); })()

steps.name: kick-install
steps.eval: void Promise.all([import('/src/catalog/packs/registry.ts'), import('/src/catalog/packs/install.ts')]).then(([r, i]) => i.installPolyHavenBundle(r.AVAILABLE_PACKS.find(p => p.id === 'poly-haven-plants'))).then(() => { window.__phInstalled = true }).catch(e => { window.__phInstallErr = String(e && e.message || e) })

steps.name: wait-install

waitFor.store: window.__phInstallErr ? (() => { throw new Error('install failed: ' + window.__phInstallErr) })() : state.packFurniture.filter(d => d.packId === 'poly-haven-plants').length >= 2

steps.failMessage: expected >=2 packed Poly Haven plant items (network to dl.polyhaven.org may be blocked headless)

steps.name: assert-real-metre-scale

waitFor.store: state.packFurniture.filter(d => d.packId === 'poly-haven-plants').every(d => d.defaultFootprint && d.defaultFootprint.h > 0.1 && d.defaultFootprint.h < 2.5 && d.defaultFootprint.w > 0.05 && d.defaultFootprint.w < 2)

steps.failMessage: packed items should have a plausible real-metre footprint, not a 1x1x1 placeholder

steps.name: place-plants
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); const room = s.floorPlan.rooms.find(r => r.id === 'livingDining'); const ox = room.origin[0]; const oz = room.origin[1]; s.addItem({ defId: 'poly-haven-plants:pachira_aquatica_01', position: [ox + 1.2, oz + 1.4], rotation: 0, props: {} }); s.addItem({ defId: 'poly-haven-plants:potted_plant_02', position: [ox + 2.2, oz + 1.4], rotation: 0, props: {} }); })()
